def process(teneanBeach, mStreetBeach, cityPointBeach, carsonBeach, constitutionBeach, malibuBeach, wollastonBeach, pleasureBayCastleIsland) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np

    def tidy_single_site(df: pd.DataFrame, beach_name: str, site_name: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
        # Real header is in row 1
        tmp = df.copy()
        tmp.columns = tmp.iloc[1].tolist()
        tmp = tmp.iloc[2:].copy()
        tmp = tmp.rename(columns={
            '1-Day Rain': 'rain1',
            '2-Day Rain': 'rain2',
            '3-Day Rain': 'rain3',
            'Enterococcus': 'enterococcus',
            'Date': 'date'
        })
        # keep only relevant
        keep = ['date', 'rain1', 'rain2', 'rain3', 'enterococcus']
        tmp = tmp[keep]
        tmp['beach'] = beach_name
        tmp['site'] = site_name
        # types
        tmp['date'] = pd.to_datetime(tmp['date'], errors='coerce')
        for c in ['rain1', 'rain2', 'rain3', 'enterococcus']:
            tmp[c] = pd.to_numeric(tmp[c], errors='coerce')
        return tmp

    def tidy_multi_site(df: pd.DataFrame, beach_name: str, sites: list[tuple[str,int,int]]) -> pd.DataFrame:
        # sites: list of (site_name, tag_col_index, ent_col_index) in the raw df
        tmp = df.copy()
        header = tmp.iloc[1].tolist()
        tmp.columns = header
        tmp = tmp.iloc[2:].copy()
        tmp = tmp.rename(columns={'Date': 'date', '1-Day Rain': 'rain1', '2-Day Rain': 'rain2', '3-Day Rain': 'rain3'})
        base = tmp[['date','rain1','rain2','rain3']].copy()
        base['date'] = pd.to_datetime(base['date'], errors='coerce')
        for c in ['rain1','rain2','rain3']:
            base[c] = pd.to_numeric(base[c], errors='coerce')

        out = []
        cols = list(tmp.columns)
        for site_name, tag_i, ent_i in sites:
            tag_col = cols[tag_i]
            ent_col = cols[ent_i]
            part = base.copy()
            part['enterococcus'] = pd.to_numeric(tmp[ent_col], errors='coerce')
            # ignore tag column; values like '<'/'>' indicate censoring but numeric column already holds value
            part['beach'] = beach_name
            part['site'] = site_name
            out.append(part)
        return pd.concat(out, ignore_index=True)

    frames = []
    frames.append(tidy_single_site(teneanBeach, 'Tenean Beach', 'Tenean Beach'))
    frames.append(tidy_single_site(mStreetBeach, 'M Street Beach', 'M Street Beach'))
    frames.append(tidy_single_site(cityPointBeach, 'City Point Beach', 'City Point Beach'))
    frames.append(tidy_single_site(malibuBeach, 'Malibu Beach', 'Malibu Beach'))

    # Carson: two sites: I Street (Unnamed:4 tag, Unnamed:5 ent), McCormack Bathhouse (Unnamed:6 tag, Unnamed:7 ent)
    frames.append(tidy_multi_site(carsonBeach, 'Carson Beach', [('I Street', 4, 5), ('McCormack Bathhouse', 6, 7)]))

    # Constitution: North (4,5), Middle (6,7), South (8,9)
    frames.append(tidy_multi_site(constitutionBeach, 'Constitution Beach', [('North', 4, 5), ('Middle', 6, 7), ('South', 8, 9)]))

    # Wollaston: Milton Road (4,5), Channing Street (6,7), Sachem Street (8,9), Rice Road (10,11)
    frames.append(tidy_multi_site(wollastonBeach, 'Wollaston Beach', [('Milton Road', 4, 5), ('Channing Street', 6, 7), ('Sachem Street', 8, 9), ('Rice Road', 10, 11)]))

    # Pleasure bay + castle island: Pleasure Bay @ Broadway (4,5), Pleasure Bay @ Flagpole (6,7), Castle Island Playground (8,9)
    frames.append(tidy_multi_site(pleasureBayCastleIsland, 'Pleasure Bay / Castle Island', [('Pleasure Bay @ Broadway', 4, 5), ('Pleasure Bay @ Flagpole', 6, 7), ('Castle Island Playground', 8, 9)]))

    all_samples = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)

    # Condition: no rainfall in preceding three days
    no_rain = all_samples[(all_samples['rain1'] == 0) & (all_samples['rain2'] == 0) & (all_samples['rain3'] == 0)]

    # Fail standard: enterococcus >= 104 (meets if < 104)
    fails = no_rain[no_rain['enterococcus'] >= 104]

    beach_counts = fails.groupby('beach').size().reset_index(name='failed_samples_no_rain_3d')
    beach_counts = beach_counts.sort_values(['failed_samples_no_rain_3d', 'beach'], ascending=[False, True]).reset_index(drop=True)
    return beach_counts
